title: Fettuccine With Asparagus And Smoked Salmon
description: Fresh pasta, asparagus and smoked salmon are tossed with shallot cream sauce in this elegant weeknight dinner that can be prepared in well under an hour.
ingredients: 1 cup (or a little less) cream or half-and-half
8 ounces fresh fettuccine noodles (maybe green ones)
directions: Snap off the ends of the asparagus where they break naturally and peel the stalks (if they’re thick). Cut the asparagus on a slant to pieces about an inch long.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil for the pasta.

While the water is coming to a boil, melt the butter in a large heavy skillet. Add the shallots and saute until soft but not brown. Stir in the cream and simmer about five minutes, until the cream has thickened somewhat.
Cut the salmon into slivers, add it to the cream and remove the skillet from the heat. Season with pepper and lemon juice.

When the pot of water is boiling, add the fettuccine, stir it once or twice, then cook the required time. In the last two minutes add the asparagus slices. Drain well (saving a little juice in case needed for the pasta).
Briefly reheat the sauce. Transfer the fettuccine and asparagus to a warm serving bowl, pour the sauce over it and toss. Sprinkle with dill (maybe some lemon zest) and serve.
